locations.title: Locations
locations.description: Cities, neighbourhoods or areas to search, e.g. 'Paris', 'Berlin Mitte', 'near Times Square'.

checkIn.title: Check-in date
checkIn.description: Arrival date (YYYY-MM-DD). Leave empty to let Google pick its default dates.

checkOut.title: Check-out date
checkOut.description: Departure date (YYYY-MM-DD). Required when check-in is set.

country.title: Google region
country.description: Google region used for the search. Google decides the price currency from the server location, so use 'Convert prices to' for a fixed currency.

currency.title: Convert prices to
currency.description: Optional. Adds converted prices in this currency using the European Central Bank's daily reference rates. Original prices are always kept.

maxResultsPerLocation.title: Max hotels per location
maxResultsPerLocation.description: Upper limit of hotels saved per location (Google shows about 18-20 on the first results page).

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Proxy used to reach Google. The default Apify proxy works for most runs.
